title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode6 Up Against a Wall

meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park - Plaza

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Eat these rice balls!
I just bought them from that shop over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
You haven't had lunch yet, right?
Let's sit on that bench and have these together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-But... Shouldn't we be looking for the thief...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yes, that's important.
However...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I heard your body's message loud and clear!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
You can't fight on an empty stomach!
I know you want to catch him, but you need to eat first!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
That also goes for shows. You can't put on a good performance if your physical condition is subpar.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'll gladly have these!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Delicious! This rice ball is delicious!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I know you're hungry, but be careful not to choke on them.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I also got us some tea. I'll leave yours right here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Alright, once you finish eating that, we'll resume our investigation!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And... Thank you again for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel much better now because of you, Mr. Kijima.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was beating myself up and feeling awful about letting that thief go...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I could tell...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I feel like there's more on your mind than just that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's launching himself higher by kicking the wall...! This technique...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's wall jumping...!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seeing the way he wall jumped has me thinking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I wish I were faster...
I wish I could wall jump like that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I know what I'm supposed to do.
In my mind, I've succeeded at launching myself off the ground, kicking the wall and keeping my jump straight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But my body hasn't been able to keep up.
No matter how hard I trained, I've failed to succeed in reality.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's been so frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Despite having a clear image in your head, you can't seem to execute...
The pain that brings is a difficult one to describe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Have you gone through a similar experience, Mr. Kijima?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! I have!
I am human, after all!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, my situation was a little different from yours. I ran into a wall in terms of my acting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your acting...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Haha. You sound surprised.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I actually used to be a wrestler.
Acting was far from my strong suit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! A wrestler...?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's all I did since I was little.
I even won nationals when I was in high school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-Nationals?! You won...?!
That's incredible...!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah. Right?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But I hurt my shoulder during my last tournament...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I didn't have any trouble doing day-to-day things, but it basically spelled the end of my prospects of competing internationally. That became clear after just a few attempts...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
My injury was keeping me from succeeding.
I couldn't go where I wanted because of it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That must've been agonizing...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, it was...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: By the time I entered university, I was so lost. I had no goals. I didn't know what to do with myself.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: All I did was waste time doing nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Then, one day, I was introduced to...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Shows and acting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I got to see my university's theatre group perform during our festival. There were hardly any people watching...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But that was the first show I'd ever seen, and I was so moved.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Particularly by the actors' bodies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Their bodies...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Until then, I'd only ever focused on creating a body that could help me win bouts.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I took my body to the limit in order to defeat my opponents in an all-out contest. And hearing the audience roar always gave me a huge rush.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I trained and worked out just for that.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Which is why I was so staggered when I saw that show and those actors' bodies...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
They weren't using their bodies to win.
They were using their bodies to become a character, express how they feel and tell a story. It felt like such a new perspective...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That was when I felt I wanted to try doing the same thing. I wanted to feel happiness by moving the hearts of others.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, I applied to join that same day.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
But I didn't know anything about theatre...
All I knew was how to wrestle. “Bad” didn't even come close to describing my acting at first.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The seniors were so appalled by my performances that they couldn't help but laugh. Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wow...
I never would've guessed...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Fortunately, my acting skills did slowly begin to improve.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But I ran into several obstacles along the way.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'd get told, “You need to say that line with more feeling,” or, “The way you're moving isn't bad, but not good either.”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Whenever I thought I was doing a good job, I was always doing too much or not enough... I could never get my acting just right.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Getting to where I am now was hard...
Probably harder than winning nationals for wrestling...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Anyway, what I'm trying to say is...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Be it acting or sword fighting, doing what you picture in your head is incredibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But we just have to keep trying our best.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: We have to use whatever tricks we can, look for new methods and push ourselves to become better. Only those who keep pursuing perfection can approach the acting style they want.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Use whatever tricks I can, look for new methods and keep pushing myself to become better...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He's right...
That's exactly what I've been doing until now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've been accepting my shortcomings while slowly making progress and moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means, this time is no different.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: All that said, I do have a piece of advice for you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I happened to meet a former cast member yesterday who used to play the most popular ninja here, and I asked if he knew how to wall jump.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: He's roughly the same height and build as you, so I thought he'd be able to provide some tips.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Wh-What did he say...?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: He graciously gave me some nice tips!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Wall jumping is all about...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've been overlooking that this entire time!
I'll give it a try after we've dealt with that thief!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Right! If you're able to figure out how to wall jump and we're able to perform again, I may have you do that during our show.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
So, Tenma, don't give up!
Keep trying! Keep doing your best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's calling.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hello? This is Kijima.
What...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The thief's coming our way?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: A bit west of the main street. That's precisely where we are! Okay, we'll ambush him in front of the tea shop!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Tenma!
Mind lending me a hand blocking this street?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have an idea!!!
